Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <D4r9v...@dutiws.twi.tudelft.nl>,

Johan Meijdam <jo...@pa.twi.tudelft.nl> wrote:
>What happens when the vampire the rack 'points to' is grave robbed to
>another methusalah? May the controller of the rack choose a new
>'target' or does the rack still work for the same vampire, but remain
>under the first methusalah's control?

The Rack only changes its pointer when the Rack card changes
controllers. If the pointer points to a dead vampire, it doesn't do
anything. From this, my guess would be that it would keep pointing to
the same vampire even if the vampire moved.
